about: Web-researched evidence for individual businesses (research-census). Facts only (name, address, phone), each with the URL it came from. confidence = how sure we are the business is open there today: official store locator / company page 0.9-0.95, directory or delivery listing 0.8-0.85, dated guide 0.6-0.75. Entries without lat/lon are geocoded from 'address' on OSM house numbers by 05_merge.py and merged with the same business from other sources.
